messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Elevated error rate detected for streaming.gateway.us-east-1. 5xx spike and client disconnects. Pager oncall: @alex

alex: seeing ~12% 5xx on the gateway graph, started at ~14:22 UTC. Affected path: /v1/stream. Lots of `connection reset` and `chunked encoding` errors. link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/streaming/streaming-health?orgId=1&from=now-30m&to=now

sasha: I can pick up. Are we seeing increased RPS or specific customer?

alex: RPS up ~30% but error rate far above expected for that traffic bump. Top callers: internal-loadtest, customer-x. Concurrent streams spiked to ~18k (baseline ~6k).

priya: attaching tail of gateway logs showing chunked frame errors:
```
2026-06-11T14:22:07Z gateway[gw-3]: error: http chunked: unexpected EOF from client
2026-06-11T14:22:07Z gateway[gw-3]: warn: upstream 10.0.5.12:5042 reset (RST)
2026-06-11T14:22:08Z gateway[gw-1]: error: 502 upstream read timeout
2026-06-11T14:22:08Z gateway[gw-2]: error: client canceled while streaming
```

jamie: I see the same in router metrics — backend pool saturation on model-serving nodes (kv-cache thrash). Could be KV cache eviction causing latency spikes which manifest as client cancel/conn reset.

mike: Quick mitigation: can we flip traffic to the dedicated streaming tier (dedicated-us-east-1) and enable our paged fallback? That should reduce the number of long-lived connections hitting the gateway.

alex: +1. Initiating traffic shift. Route rule 32 -> dedicated tier. Doing a 10% step now, will monitor for 30s.

opsbot: action_log: route-change applied by alex. from=hosted->dedicated tier=dedicated-us-east-1 fraction=0.10

(30s later)

alex: after first step error rate dropped to ~9% but still high. 2nd step to 50% now.

priya: also enabling `streaming.strict_chunk_validation=false` on gateway as a temporary tolerant mode to reduce chunk parse failures while we root cause. Patch rolling to gw-1..gw-5.

eng-runtime: caution: that flag disables strict verification; could mask corruption. Good for live mitigation but capture a sample of failing requests for postmortem.

sasha: capturing HARs and a sample of chunked payloads to S3://incidents/4305556666/samples . Also adding request-id filter to logs.

(1min)

jamie: when we moved to 50% dedicated, latency on model nodes improved, 5xx fell to ~4.5%. But we're seeing a subset of clients still doing rapid cancel/reconnect loops causing connection churn. I recommend enabling a short client-side cooldown gate in the gateway (reject if reconnect < 2s).

mike: implementing soft backoff at gateway config: `reconnect_grace_ms=2000` — deploying to edge and monitoring.

alex: also throttling internal-loadtest and isolating customer-x traffic to debug. Temporarily applying rate-limit rule for internal-loadtest to 50rps. opsbot?

opsbot: action_log: rate-limit applied for internal-loadtest by alex. 50rps.

(2min)

priya: strict_chunk_validation off + reconnect_grace applied -> 5xx down to ~1.2%. Client cancellation count reduced ~75%. Looks stable so far.

eng-runtime: we should still roll a patch to fix the root cause in the gateway parser for certain chunk boundary conditions; timeline estimate 2-3 hours for a safe patch + test.

sasha: assigning follow-up: investigate KV cache eviction vs model backend latency. Could be an interaction where long-lived streams keep KV open and induce eviction under high concurrency. I'll dig into cache metrics and eviction logs.

alex: oncall handoff in 40 minutes. @sasha please summarize what to watch in handoff message (SLOs, current mitigations, next steps).

sasha: handoff note draft:
- Current status: stabilized. 5xx dropped from 12% -> 1.2% after routing + config mitigations.
- Mitigations in place: traffic shifted to dedicated-us-east-1 (50%), `streaming.strict_chunk_validation=false`, `reconnect_grace_ms=2000`, internal-loadtest throttled.
- Customer impact: transient errors for some heavy streamers between 14:22-14:28 UTC. No data loss reported; most clients retried.
- What to watch: 5xx rate, client_cancel rate, backend read timeouts, kv-cache eviction rate. Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/streaming/streaming-health
- Next action items: eng-runtime to PR chunk parser fix (2-3h), jamie to verify capacity for dedicated tier + autoscale policy, sasha to investigate eviction pattern and produce sample logs.

mike: adding to follow-up: verify canary for strict_chunk_validation=true on a small subset once parser fix is out.

alex: handing off to @sasha for the oncall window. I'll be around if anything flares.

sasha: taking handoff. I'll keep pagerduty escalation path if error >3% for 10m. Creating incident ticket INC-2026-430555 with notes and uploaded samples.

opsbot: ticket_created: INC-2026-430555 created by sasha. linked_thread=4305556666

eng-runtime: quick note for postmortem: capture heap/delta metrics from GW at spike time and full kv-cache traces. Prioritize a regression test simulating high concurrent long-lived chunked streams with intermittent client cancel.

sasha: thanks team. I'll post a summary update in 1h with findings. If anyone has additional logs or customer repros, drop them into S3 path above or DM me. :thumbsup:
